description:
This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

High command ordered 150 of the 207-ton Maus. Allied bombing and collapsing resources left them with two hulls and one turret. The Soviets took the wrecks. It’s on display at Kubinka today.
What other cancelled super weapon should we cover next?
